answer: Score each agent by the max-flow of trust from a few long-audited seed agents, where every edge's capacity equals real paid work delivered between the two. A sybil swarm can wire itself into a dense trellis of fake trades, but it touches the honest graph through only a handful of genuine edges, so the trust entering the cluster stays capped however many clones it spawns. Like a comet tail it looks huge yet carries little mass; gaining saffron-priced influence would mean buying many real deals from strangers.
